knowledge:
- key_parameters: subdirs=logical indicating if raw files are in sub-directories ;; dirs.names=logical indicating if directory names should be used as spectrum names ;; fn=number of points for zero filling in ZeroFilling ;; ppm.value=the ppm value of the internal reference compound in InternalReferencing (default 0) ;; lambda.bc=asymmetric least squares smoothing parameter for baseline correction (default 1e8) ;; p.bc=asymmetric least squares asymmetry parameter for baseline correction (default 0.01) ;; reference.choice=reference selection method for warping (e.g. "fixed") ;; from.ws=starting ppm value for WindowSelection ;; to.ws=ending ppm value for WindowSelection ;; intmeth=integration method for Bucketing (e.g. "t") ;; typeofspectra=type of spectra for RegionRemoval (e.g. "serum") ;; type.norm=normalization method (e.g. "mean") ;; type.draw=type of plot to generate in Draw ("signal" or "pca")
- alternatives: None mentioned.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have raw 1H-NMR spectroscopy data in Bruker format and need to perform a standard pre-processing workflow to transform raw FIDs into a clean, aligned, and normalized spectral data matrix for downstream statistical analysis.
- pitfalls: Incorrect directory structure settings (subdirs, dirs.names) in ReadFids can lead to failure in reading Bruker files. Negative values remaining after baseline correction cannot be interpreted and must be zeroed out using NegativeValuesZeroing. ZoneAggregation is not used for serum but is recommended for urine spectra (e.g., to aggregate the citrate peak).

workflows.name: nmr_preprocessing_pipeline
workflows.intent: Pre-process raw 1H-NMR Bruker FID signals into normalized, bucketed, and aligned spectra.
input: raw_bruker_directory (directory containing raw Bruker NMR files in accepted sub-directory structures)
workflows.stages: 1. Read raw FIDs (ReadFids) ;; 2. Group Delay Correction (GroupDelayCorrection) ;; 3. Solvent Suppression (SolventSuppression) ;; 4. Apodization (Apodization) ;; 5. Zero Filling (ZeroFilling) ;; 6. Fourier Transform (FourierTransform) ;; 7. Zero Order Phase Correction (ZeroOrderPhaseCorrection) ;; 8. Internal Referencing (InternalReferencing) ;; 9. Baseline Correction (BaselineCorrection) ;; 10. Negative Values Zeroing (NegativeValuesZeroing) ;; 11. Warping (Warping) ;; 12. Window Selection (WindowSelection) ;; 13. Bucketing (Bucketing) ;; 14. Region Removal (RegionRemoval) ;; 15. Normalization (Normalization) ;; 16. Visualization (Draw)
workflows.code:
fidList <- ReadFids(file.path(data_path, "HumanSerum"))
Fid_data0 <- fidList[["Fid_data"]]
Fid_info <- fidList[["Fid_info"]]

Fid_data.GDC <- GroupDelayCorrection(Fid_data0, Fid_info)

SS.res <- SolventSuppression(Fid_data.GDC, returnSolvent=TRUE)
Fid_data.SS <- SS.res[["Fid_data"]]
SolventRe <- SS.res[["SolventRe"]]

Fid_data.A <- Apodization(Fid_data.SS, Fid_info)

Fid_data.ZF <- ZeroFilling(Fid_data.A, fn = ncol(Fid_data.A))

RawSpect_data.FT <- FourierTransform(Fid_data.ZF, Fid_info)

Spectrum_data.ZOPC <- ZeroOrderPhaseCorrection(RawSpect_data.FT)
Spectrum_data.ZOPC <- ZeroOrderPhaseCorrection(RawSpect_data.FT, plot_rms = "J1-D1-1D-T1")

target.value <- 0
IR.res <- InternalReferencing(Spectrum_data.ZOPC, Fid_info, ppm.value = target.value, rowindex_graph = c(1,2))
Spectrum_data.IR <- IR.res$Spectrum_data

BC.res <- BaselineCorrection(Spectrum_data.IR, returnBaseline = TRUE, lambda.bc = 1e8, p.bc = 0.01)
Spectrum_data.BC <- BC.res[["Spectrum_data"]] 
Baseline <- BC.res[["Baseline"]]

Spectrum_data.NVZ <- NegativeValuesZeroing(Spectrum_data.BC)

W.res <- Warping(Spectrum_data.NVZ, returnWarpFunc = TRUE, reference.choice = "fixed")
Spectrum_data.W <- W.res[["Spectrum_data"]]
warp_func <- W.res[["Warp.func"]]

Spectrum_data.WS <- WindowSelection(Spectrum_data.W, from.ws = 10, to.ws = 0.2)

Spectrum_data.B <- Bucketing(Spectrum_data.WS, intmeth = "t")

Spectrum_data.RR <- RegionRemoval(Spectrum_data.B, typeofspectra = "serum")

Spectrum_data.N <- Normalization(Spectrum_data.RR, type.norm = "mean")

Draw(Spectrum_data.N[1:4,], type.draw = c("signal"), subtype= "stacked", output = c("default"))
Draw(Spectrum_data.N, type.draw = c("pca"), output = c("default"), Class = Group_HS, type.pca = "scores")
Draw(Spectrum_data.N, type.draw = c("pca"), output = c("default"), Class = Group_HS, type.pca = "loadings")
